acceptance_criterion: Only the assigned coordinator for the event can withdraw that event's pending request
test_name: refuses anyone but the event's assigned coordinator, changing nothing (L2-T2)

acceptance_criterion: Withdrawal is available only while the request status is Pending; approved or rejected requests offer no withdraw action
test_name: refuses a request that isn't pending, naming its status, and an unknown one (L2-T3)

acceptance_criterion: On withdrawal the status becomes Withdrawn and the acting user and timestamp are recorded; the request record is retained, not deleted
test_name: withdraws a pending request, recording who and when, and keeps the record (L2-T1)

acceptance_criterion: The withdrawn request no longer appears in the Venue Staff queue and no longer appears as pending on the calendar
test_name: takes the request off the Venue Staff queue and the calendar (L2-T4, L2-T5)

acceptance_criterion: Withdrawal does not change the event's status
test_name: leaves the event untouched: its status and its version (L2-T6)
